text: The Dread King marches again! Amassing an army of ancient undead warriors at the Pools of Despair, he sets out to reconquer Nehekhara and Araby in the name of the Great Necromancer.

The Dread King marches north! Sensing the presence of an ancient servant of Nagash imprisoned beneath the ice in the frozen lands of Kislev, the Dark Lord of Nagash arrives at the ancient barrow grounds of Macadone.
